enabled.title: Show my activity on Discord
enabled.description: Show your active OpenIDEA project and file status on your Discord profile.

details.title: First line while editing
details.description: Placeholders: {file}, {language}, {project}, {branch}. Leave out what you don't want to share.

idleDetails.title: First line with no file open

idleState.title: Second line with no file open

idleText.title: Idle line
idleText.description: Shown on Discord when idle. Placeholders: {project}, {branch}.

detectIdle.title: Detect Inactivity (AFK)
detectIdle.description: Automatically update presence to idle when away from the keyboard.

idleTimeoutMins.title: Inactivity Timeout (Minutes)
idleTimeoutMins.description: Minutes of inactivity before switching to idle state (0: never).

whileIdle.title: Status When Inactive
whileIdle.description: How your Discord profile appears while idle.

resetOpenTimeOnReturn.title: Reset Timer on Return
resetOpenTimeOnReturn.description: Reset session elapsed timer when returning from idle inactivity.

sessionTimeoutMins.title: Session Inactivity Timeout (Minutes)
sessionTimeoutMins.description: Minutes of inactivity after which a new session timer is started (default: 30 minutes).

timeMode.title: Elapsed Time Counter
timeMode.description: How the elapsed session counter displays on Discord.

prefixReadingEditing.title: Prefix Files with 'Editing'
prefixReadingEditing.description: Automatically prefix file names with 'Editing ' if {file} is used.

applicationTheme.title: IDE Badge Icon Theme
applicationTheme.description: Icon theme for the OpenIDEA badge.

languageTheme.title: File Language Icon Theme
languageTheme.description: Icon theme for programming languages and file extensions.

privacyMode.title: Privacy Mode
privacyMode.description: Hide file and project names completely from your Discord profile.

hideSensitiveFiles.title: Hide files that may hold secrets
hideSensitiveFiles.description: .env files, keys, certificates, keystores, secrets, and private directories are shown as 'a private file', without their name or logo.

showGitButton.title: Show 'View Repository' Button
showGitButton.description: Add a button on Discord linking to your repository (GitHub/GitLab).

showIDEButton.title: Show 'Get OpenIDEA' Button
showIDEButton.description: Add a button on Discord linking to OpenIDEA.

customButtonLabel.title: Custom Button Label
customButtonLabel.description: Up to 32 characters. Discord shows at most two buttons: Repository, Custom, then OpenIDEA.

customButtonUrl.title: Custom Button Link
customButtonUrl.description: An https:// address for your custom button.
